name: Learn Coach
description:
Learn Coach is an AI-native study companion designed for Even G2. It helps learners turn vocabulary lists, short notes, pasted text, and lightweight study materials into clear flashcards that can be reviewed directly on the glasses. Instead of showing dense pages of information, Learn Coach presents one focused card at a time with very large, glanceable text, making it suitable for short review sessions, walking practice, language learning, and quick memory reinforcement throughout the day.

The experience is built around active recall rather than passive reading. A learner can read a card aloud, move to the next card, mark a card as known, or ask the coach for a quick question. The app is intentionally minimal on the G2 display: the front of the card, the answer or hint, a short coach prompt, and progress information. This keeps the glasses interface calm and readable while leaving the phone screen available for importing content, changing settings, and managing the study session.

Learn Coach is designed to support voice-first learning. Simple voice commands such as next, repeat, known, or ask can be used to control the study flow. For pronunciation and read-aloud practice, the app can listen for speech input and use it to trigger card switching or coaching feedback. This makes the learning loop feel natural: look at a word, say it aloud, recall the meaning, then continue without needing to touch the phone every time.

The AI coaching layer adds more than basic flashcard display. When importing study material, AI can help convert raw text into structured learning cards with concise prompts. During review, the coach can generate short recall questions, ask for an example sentence, request an explanation in the learner's own words, or provide a brief follow-up prompt. The goal is not to overwhelm the learner with long explanations, but to create small moments of retrieval practice that strengthen memory.

The first version is especially useful for vocabulary practice, phrase memorization, terminology review, and compact knowledge reinforcement. Example use cases include learning English words, reviewing technical terms, memorizing key points from a meeting note, preparing for an exam, or turning a short article into study prompts. The app works best with small batches of focused material where each card can be answered in a few seconds.

Learn Coach is also designed as a practical AI-native learning prototype for smart glasses. It combines Even G2 display containers, simple list controls, microphone-based interaction, import-to-card conversion, and real-time tutor prompts into one lightweight flow. The app can run with local fallback behavior for basic flashcard practice, while an external AI or speech service can be connected for richer import, coaching, and transcription capabilities.

The guiding principle is simple: keep the glasses display extremely readable, keep each interaction short, and use AI only when it makes the learner think more actively. Learn Coach aims to make Even G2 feel like a quiet personal study partner that helps users practice more often, with less friction, and with just enough guidance to make each review session meaningful.
